text:
sam_sales: GreenHaven procurement emailed a PO + internal compliance checklist. Big asks: separate invoice per legal entity, PO number on every invoice line, bank details and remit address on each invoice, and MSA signed before any invoice. Can we map this?
rita_legal: MSA-first is fine. Need to know whether each subsidiary will sign the MSA or only the order form. They included a DPA with two HSM/KMS bullets we need to redline.
paul_billing: Billing can emit one PDF per billing_entity_id with PO lines included. We need po_line_id in the order schema to show PO references per line. Also procurement wants ACH details on the invoice (bank name, account last4). We prefer a masked bank reference for security.
anya_cs: POC details: Dedicated reserved for 45 days, then convert to reserved commitment. Customer also asked for an explicit "POC credit" line so they don't auto-pay for pilot.
mike_finance: Our default for pilots is net30 + 25% deposit for hardware reservation. Customer asked net45 and no deposit. Finance will consider net45 if deposit is at least 30% or we get a payment guarantee.
san_sales: They also request a 12-month price hold for SKUs listed on the order form and a clause that PO binds pricing on day0. We need legal review on pricing lock.
rita_legal: Draft KMS/HSM redline: "Customer-managed KMS/HSM permitted; Customer retains sole custody of private key material. Redwood will integrate with customer key references but will not have access to unencrypted key material. Audit scope related to key handling to be mutually agreed; indemnity limited to willful misconduct." If procurement pushes full indemnity, escalate to counsel.
paul_billing: Ops note: to output separate invoices with PO line refs we'll add fields: billing_entity_id, po_number, po_line_id, remit_bank_meta. Billing/API change estimate: 2 business days to deploy, 1 day to QA.
mike_finance: Proposed deposit schedule if net45: 30% due at countersign, 70% invoiced on day0 net45. If legal insists no deposit, finance cannot approve net45.
anya_cs: I'll prepare a cover note and attach SOC2 and subprocessor list; procurement explicitly requested subprocessors and audit evidence.
docusign-bot: docusign: template created (tmpl-gh-multi). Please review signer roles.
rita_legal: Recommended signing flow: single consolidated MSA envelope where customer execs (per-entity legal reps) sign once, then per-entity order form envelopes (Order Form + PO acknowledgement) that reference the MSA ID. This keeps the audit trail and allows per-entity invoices.
sam_sales: Sounds good. Procurement also wants to map which party countersigns what (legal vs finance). Can we include a signer mapping table in the DocuSign cover: Exec -> MSA, Procurement -> Order Form, Finance -> PO ack.
paul_billing: We'll include the PO fields in the order payload and ensure invoice generation uses billing_entity_id in PDF metadata. We will also add a note: "PO-bound-on-day0: true" to the order for audit.
mike_finance: Once legal finalizes the redline and confirms deposit %, finance can approve net45 for the pilot.
anya_cs: Action list: 1) @rita_legal finalize HSM redline and return snippet (EOD), 2) @paul_billing ship order schema changes + invoice template (2 business days), 3) @mike_finance confirm deposit text, 4) @anya_cs attach SOC2/subprocessors and prepare DocuSign envelopes.
docusign-bot: envelope created (env_gh_5555) for MSA; please QA signers.
sam_sales: I'll QA envelope and post final order form here before send. :thumbsup:
